## Crusoe Intelligence Foundry

Latest models

Explore a curated selection of top-performing models from leading AI labs, ranging from lightweight and ultra-fast models to large models with frontier reasoning power. Using a proprietary model? [Connect with our team](/managed-inference/tailored-deployment/request).

Seamless customization

Quickly adapt models with your proprietary data. Serverless Fine-Tuning gets you from data upload to an improved model in a few clicks. No cluster provisioning. No surprise bills. Full portability.

Scalable inference

Serve models with up to 9.9x faster time to first token, ultra- low latency, and 5x higher throughput vs vLLM. Serverless Inference, Self-Serve Deployments, and Tailored Deployments are now available for greater flexibility.
